# Dictation.io

> Free online speech recognition tool powered by Google Speech Recognition for hands-free voice dictation across 100+ languages.

Dictation.io provides a web-based voice input interface that leverages Google's speech recognition technology through the Web Speech API. It supports multiple languages and offers voice commands for controlling dictation, making it an accessible alternative to traditional keyboard input for writing emails, documents, and other text.
